properties.description: Enter the feedback text. It must be nonblank and no longer than 5000 characters. The workflow never copies it into diagnostic or terminal outputs.

properties.name: Email
properties.description: Enter the feedback sender's valid email address. It is sent only in FeedbackData and is not copied into workflow result or error output.

properties.name: Account Name

properties.name: Evaluation
properties.description: For Feedback Type Evaluation, choose Excellent, Good, Fair, or Poor. Leave blank for Bug or Survey. This API property is deprecated and sunsets on 2027-02-20.

properties.name: Follow Up
properties.description: Allow Cisco to follow up about this submission. Alternative follow-up addresses require this value to be true.

properties.name: Alternative Follow-up Emails
properties.description: Optional JSON array of at most five valid, unique email addresses. Use [] when none are required. Values are never copied into terminal outputs.

properties.name: Product Satisfaction Scale
properties.description: Optional satisfaction score from 0 through 10. Leave the default -1 to omit ProductSatisfactionScale from the API body.

properties.name: Survey Completed
properties.description: For Feedback Type Survey, indicate whether the survey was completed. This must remain false for other feedback types.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final status code for workflow input validation, API submission, or response validation.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Privacy-minimized JSON result containing only submission status and returned resource identity; never the comment or email addresses.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable final workflow outcome without submitted personal data.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail without submitted personal data; empty on success.

Submits Evaluation, Bug, or Survey feedback as feedback.FeedbackPost with nested FeedbackData. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can create feedback posts. The workflow validates enums, a 5,000-character Comment, email formats, at most five alternative addresses, 0-10 satisfaction, and type-specific fields; FullStoryUrl and TraceIds are omitted. Diagnostics and outputs never echo Comment or email values, although the API transmits them. Evaluation is deprecated with OpenAPI sunset 2027-02-20 and must migrate when Cisco publishes a replacement. Creation is non-idempotent: ambiguous POST results are not retried and may already have created a resource. HTTP 2xx plus validated identity proves acceptance, not review/follow-up. Generic APIs are used because no feedback atomic exists.

Submits a feedback.FeedbackPost using the selected Intersight endpoint and its default runtime user. A generic request is required because no purpose-built feedback atomic is present; replace it with a supported purpose-built atomic when available. This operation is intentionally non-idempotent: automatic retry after an ambiguous transport failure could create duplicate feedback.

Separates ambiguous transport failure from a confirmed non-2xx response. Because the POST is non-idempotent, transport failure warns that the submission may already exist and must not be retried automatically; a confirmed HTTP failure preserves the returned status code without echoing a potentially sensitive body.

properties.description: Parses the successful POST response and returns only the new feedback resource Moid and ObjectType. It never copies FeedbackData, Comment, Email, alternative addresses, or the raw response into helper diagnostics or terminal outputs.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

responseStatus = "helper-failure"
responseStatusCode = "500"
responseMessage = "Feedback response validation did not complete."
responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response validation helper failed"}, separators=(",", ":"))
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        responseStatus = "invalid"
        responseStatusCode = "502"
        responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight returned a non-object feedback response; submitted values are intentionally omitted."
        responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Invalid feedback response shape"}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        moid = body.get("Moid")
        objectType = body.get("ObjectType") or body.get("ClassId")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip() or objectType != "feedback.FeedbackPost":
            responseStatus = "invalid"
            responseStatusCode = "502"
            responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight returned a feedback response without a valid Moid and feedback.FeedbackPost type."
            responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response identity validation failed"}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            responseStatus = "ready"
            responseStatusCode = "201"
            responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted the feedback submission."
            responseResultJson = json.dumps({"created":True,"Moid":moid.strip(),"ObjectType":"feedback.FeedbackPost"}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    responseStatus = "helper-failure"
    responseStatusCode = "500"
    responseMessage = "Feedback response validation failed technically (" + type(exc).__name__ + "); submitted values are intentionally omitted."
    responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response validation helper failed","exceptionType":type(exc).__name__}, separators=(",", ":"))
